title: Wall Mount 2-Roll Reserve Toilet Paper Holder 8.5-Inch Solid Brass | Allied Brass
body_html:
Organize your bathroom and ensure you always have a backup roll ready with this space-saving vertical reserve holder. Part of the transitional Que New collection, this accessory features dramatic circular detailing that blends balanced, sophisticated style with everyday utility.

  • Durable Construction: Crafted from the finest solid brass materials for enduring quality and a premium feel.
  • Space-Saving Design: Wall-mounted vertical orientation maximizes floor space while holding two rolls of tissue.
  • Seamless Installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware is included for a clean, professional appearance on your wall.
  • Finish Variety: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement options like Unlacquered Brass and Venetian Bronze.
  • Peace of Mind: Built to last and protected by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Specifications:
- Material: Solid Brass
- Dimensions: 6.4" L x 8.5" H x 3" W
- Mounting: Wall Mounted (Hardware Included)
- Screw Size: #8 X 1 1/4"
- Weight Capacity: 2 lb
- Collection: Que New

_previous.title: Que New Collection 2 Roll Reserve Roll Toilet Paper Holder
_previous.description: Stylish and practical, the Que New 2 Roll Toilet Paper Holder is a great way to always have a back up roll available. Its design is as decorative as it is practical and sure to be a welcomed addition to any bathroom. This holder comes with all the hardware needed for easy wall mounted installation in that perfect spot. Made from all solid brass, this decorative accessory will provide a lifetime of practical use.
